title: Supreme Leader Snoke
description: As Supreme Leader of the First Order, Snoke had a powerful command of the dark side as well as the military apparatus to destroy the New Republic. Additionally, he was responsible for seducing Ben Solo to abandon the path of the Jedi and become his apprentice. Kylo Ren murdered Snoke and usurped his power but discovered quickly that Snoke was a puppet for a greater power behind the throne.
